title: Percutaneous Image-Guided Lumbar Decompression for Lumbar Spinal Stenosis
benefit_category: Outpatient Hospital Services Incident to a Physician's Service, Physicians' Services
item_service_description:
<strong><p>A. &nbsp; General</p></strong>
<p>PILD is a posterior decompression of the lumbar spine performed under indirect image guidance without any direct visualization of the surgical area. This is a procedure proposed as a treatment for symptomatic LSS unresponsive to conservative therapy. This procedure is generally described as a non-invasive procedure using specially designed instruments to percutaneously remove a portion of the lamina and debulk the ligamentum flavum. The procedure is performed under x-ray guidance (e.g., fluoroscopic, CT) with the assistance of contrast media to identify and monitor the compressed area via epiduragram.</p>
